title: Valid Parentheses
hook: Most people forget the empty-stack check here 👀
problem: Return true if every bracket is closed by the same type, in the right order.
idea: Push every opener. Each closer must match the top of the stack.

steps.say: Openers ( { [ → push them on the stack
Empty stack at the end → true ✅

tip: Always check the stack is empty at the end: "((" is invalid!
